pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Google Material Symbols installed as system TTF variable fonts: Outlined, Rounded and Sharp styles, each with FILL, GRAD, opsz and wght axes. Useful for desktop apps that pick up icon fonts from fontconfig (e.g. Electron / Tauri apps that ship CSS referencing "Material Symbols Outlined" etc.).
Upstream does not cut versioned releases for the variable fonts, so this ebuild pins a specific commit of google/material-design-icons under variablefont/.
